## SETUP (one time)

1. REQUIRED status columns: the current `datasets/tickets-eval-10.csv` already includes blank `s2_status` and `s1_status` Text columns. If your table was imported from the earlier CSV without them, add both TEXT columns by hand (Add Column) - do not re-import and duplicate the tickets. The claim step writes STALE markers before any scoring, and the update node does not auto-create columns: without `s2_status` the run stops before any model call. The CSV also predeclares all result columns as blank Text, paired S1/S2 by metric (tokens and latency first); Write Results fills them by name. Missing result columns on older tables are still created automatically on first write.
2. Table names must be exact: **Get Run Status**, **Claim Run**, **Mark Rows Stale (S2)** and **Record Progress** look their tables up BY NAME - `tickets eval 10` and `comparison runs`, spelled exactly like that. Nothing to select in those four nodes, and do NOT touch their table pickers: picking a table by hand switches the node off name lookup and can blank its column mapping.
3. Select `tickets eval 10` in the ONE node that still needs a pick (its node type has no by-name mode): **When fetching a dataset row**. **Write Results to Dataset** follows that pick automatically through an expression - do not touch its table field. Pick the `tickets eval 10` table specifically: the name-based nodes resolve that exact table. If `comparison runs` does not exist yet, import `datasets/comparison_runs.csv` as a new table - the importer names it `comparison runs` (header-only on purpose: every column imports as Text, zero rows - the workflows fill it), or create it by hand under that exact name with TEXT columns: `key`, `status`, `batch`, `expected`, `processed`, `started_at`, `completed_at`.
4. Configure your OpenAI-compatible endpoint in the **Endpoint Config** node directly in this workflow (`base_url`, `model`, `api_key`): defaults to `http://host.docker.internal:8787/v1` with `codex-local` (or switch to `http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1` for Ollama's OpenAI API, or `https://api.openai.com/v1` for Official OpenAI).

## RUN (single operator, one run at a time)

**Execute workflow** on the canvas (full run from the trigger). n8n walks all 10 rows automatically, one execution per row. Each row runs through **System 2 only** (OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint) and the `s2_*` columns are written back to the same rows: team, confidence, urgent, computed route, parse-error flag, correctness flags against `expected_team` / `expected_urgent` / `expected_route`, two latency numbers, two token counts, and a `s2_run_at` timestamp. Token counts come from `usage.prompt_tokens` (input) and `usage.completion_tokens` (generated output); a blank means the backend did not report the count. The `expected_*` label columns are never written. A parse failure gets its own route (`parse_failed`) so it can never accidentally match `human_review`.

**Latency, measured identically on both systems:** `s2_wall_ms` is the client-side wall time around the HTTP call (the same measurer wraps the S1 call in the other workflow - use wall for the headline comparison). `s2_server_ms` is the server-reported duration (if provided by the endpoint).

**Before trusting the results:** `comparison_runs` key `latest_s2` must show YOUR run from start to finish - it flips to `running` with a fresh `started_at`, and results are current only once it shows `complete` with `processed` = `expected`, and every row's `s2_run_at` is at or after the run's `started_at` - a row with an older timestamp is leftover from a previous run, not part of this one. Anything else (never went `running`, stuck `running`, old timestamps) means the visible results are not from a finished run.

**Recovery:** stop any active execution of this workflow (Executions list), set the `latest_s2` status cell to `aborted`, then rerun.

Run **System 1 Eval** separately to fill the `s1_*` columns on the same 10 rows - same tickets, same expected labels, independently executed.

value.s2_status: ={{ 'STALE since ' + $now.toISO() + ' - a new S2 run is in progress; s2_* values on this row are from a previous run' }}
